primary_checks.author: Исагулян Эмиль Давидович
primary_checks.title: Хроническая электростимуляция спинного и головного мозга в лечении нейрогенных болевых синдромов
primary_page_evidence: RSL record title identifies an author abstract, dissertation, 2006, Moscow, 26 pages; exact author/title visible in HTML title and record heading.

RSL page free-access modal states that the full document is openly available in its viewer; the server HTML exposes a "Read online" control with href="#" and no direct reader URL or MARC 856 PDF locator in the retrieved record page.
GET to the RSL viewer route https://search.rsl.ru/ru/view/01003269330 returned HTTP 400 in this environment; full text was not retrieved.
primary_checks.scope_supported_by_title_only: clinical chronic spinal and brain electrical stimulation for neurogenic pain; not evidence of ECAP measurement or Drosophila connectome methods.

primary_checks.author: Богачева Ирина Николаевна
primary_checks.title: Нейрональные механизмы формирования локомоторного паттерна при электрической стимуляции спинного мозга
primary_page_evidence: RSL record HTML title/heading and MARC 856 identify a 24-page Russian author abstract, St Petersburg, 2006, with an application/pdf link and a free-access badge.

The RSL reader link redirects to dlib.rsl.ru PDF path, which redirects to https://dlib.rsl.ru/01003282807; the final endpoint returned HTTP 200 text/html (viewer wrapper), not a PDF body to this command-line client.
The viewer application route was not renderable with the available web opener; no page text was extracted, so the methods remain uninspected.

The official archive search result links the author abstract from the Bogacheva entry; direct GET of the linked DOC returned HTTP 200, application/msword, 1,991,168 bytes. The document title matches the RSL record. Full text was opened read-only and inspected: methods describe epidural electrical spinal-cord stimulation, locomotor stepping and EMG in decerebrated cats and intact/spinalized rats.
Direct RSL PDF path redirects to JavaScript viewer HTML rather than returning a PDF to this client; method verification uses the official Pavlov Institute DOC, not a secondary mirror.
primary_checks.scope_supported_by_title_only: Primary author abstract methods: decerebrated cats and intact/spinalized rats; spinal stimulation for locomotor pattern and EMG. No Drosophila/connectome, ECAP, or nociception/pain method is reported in the inspected text.

official_repository_searches.result: Official Pavlov Institute archive confirms title/defense metadata; the 2006 archive row has no linked author-abstract/full-dissertation PDF.
No official repository document surfaced in this bounded site-scoped web search; RSL catalogue remains the checked primary record. This search result is not proof that no institutional copy exists.

limits: RSL labels both items as open in its reader, but the actual viewer pages were not extracted in this environment; availability at the institution is not equated with verified method access here.
The 01003269330 RSL page did not expose its dynamically generated reader route in retrieved HTML; a direct route attempt returned HTTP 400.
The official Pavlov Institute page confirms Bogacheva bibliographic/defense metadata but does not provide a 2006 PDF in the listed row.
No inference is made about methods beyond the titles and official catalogue metadata. Neither primary catalogue record demonstrates a Drosophila-connectome, human ECAP, and SCS combined study.
The broader NS-15 search over RSL, eLIBRARY and all official university repositories remains incomplete.
conclusion: The RSL reader route is a JavaScript wrapper in this client, but the official Pavlov Institute archive provides an open author-abstract DOC for Bogacheva. The full text is now method-checked; the other dissertation text and the broader NS-15 search remain open.
